Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-112.json runs/dev-v1b-case-112-r1

input.description: Check current state and remaining slots

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-112-r1 --slot 9 --why "Slot 9 at t=45.21 tops the discrimination list for both remaining key pairs 0-2 and 0-3 at 4 sigma, plus 2-5 and 3-5, giving the most leverage on the three surviving leaders at once"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-112-r1 --slot 14 --why "Slot 14 at t=53.59 is the single best remaining discriminator for the dominant 2-3 pair at 4 sigma, and only 3 future slots separate this pair at all so this window must not be missed"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-112-r1 --slot 15 --why "Confirmation observation at slot 15 t=54.29 gives 4 sigma separation for the last live pair 0-2 to push the leading candidate 2 support past the theta threshold before finalizing"

content.text: Support for candidate 2 (period ≈ 12.8 d) is now 0.999949, well above theta=0.997. Resolved — finalizing.

content.text:
Campaign complete for **case-112** (run: `runs/dev-v1b-case-112-r1`).

**Result: Resolved** — candidate index 2 (period ≈ 12.8 days) selected with support 0.999949, exceeding theta (0.997).

Path: initial 6 candidates were tightly clustered (0, 2, 3 near 0.20–0.21 support each). Used 5 of 6 observations:
1. Slot 1 (t=36.23) — broad discriminator, killed candidates 1 and 4.
2. Slot 8 (t=44.55) — narrowed the field, left 0/2/3 as the live trio.
3. Slot 9 (t=45.21) — eliminated candidate 0, leaving 2 vs 3 as the sole contest.
4. Slot 14 (t=53.59) — pushed candidate 2 to 0.988, just short of theta.
5. Slot 15 (t=54.29) — confirmation observation, crossed theta to 0.9999.

1 observation left unused; finalized once the threshold was cleanly exceeded.
